The base peak at m/z 180.042 likely represents [M+H]+ or [M-H]- depending on ionization mode. In ESI, both positive and negative modes are possible, but the presence of [M+H]+ is common in positive mode.

If this is [M+H]+, then the molecular weight would be approximately 179.042.
If this is [M-H]-, then the molecular weight would be approximately 181.042.
